limitations: Eleven regions across six official Vinamilk PDFs. Ten are the prior v7 reviewed regions; one additional full-page English governance scan is manually transcribed from the official image render. The set still has only one added full page, does not represent all Vietnamese OCR layouts/languages, and has one table region without cell-coordinate labels. Diagnostic comparison only; it is not eligible for engine selection.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1. Scope of regulation and subjects of application 1.l.  Scope of Regulation This internal corporate governance   regulation ("Regulation") Sets out the   principles, mechanisms and procedures of corporate govemance aimed at protecting the lawful rights and interests of shareholders; and ensuring that corporate governance is conducted ín a transparent, effective manner and in compliance with applicable laws. This   Regulation serves as basis   for shareholders   and relevant stakeholders to assess the Company's corporate governance practices: This Regulation applies to; Board members, the Chief Executive Director (#CEO')), Executive Directors, the Company Secretary, the Corporate   Governance  Officer; and other   relevant individuals and departments. This Regulation governs matters relating to: Roles, rights and obligations of the General Meeting of Shareholders (F'the GMS"), the Board, the CEO and Committees under the Board; b Procedures and fomalities for meetings of the GMS and meetings of the Board; C. Nomination; candidacy, election; removal and dismissal of Board members; tbe CEO and members of Committees; d. Coordination of activities between the Board and the CEO; Provisions relating to annual evaluation, rewards and disciplinary  actions applicable t0 Board members; the CEO and Executive Directors; and f. Other activities as provided for in the Charter and other applicable provisions of law.
1.2. Subjects of application This   Regulation shall apply to Board members; the CEO, Executive  Directors; the Company Secretary; the Corporate Govemance Officer; and other relevant individuals and departments . Article 2. Explanation of terms Unless otherwise provided by the context; terms defined in the Company's Charter shall have the same meanings when used in this Regulation.
